findings.text: negative-control procedure deviated from the named spec: the done-when required the red arm 'run from a full tree copy with --import-mode=importlib and the module __file__ printed', but live-gate-negative-control.log ran in place (REPOSITORY_ROOT is the worktree itself) through the lane wrapper with a plain pytest command, no --import-mode=importlib, and no module __file__ line; the only log that printed MODULE_FILE is the exploratory fresh-weak-exact-110.log, which is not the red arm. The red is genuine (shifted sup 0.2486673925768625, EXIT=1, one failing id the head arm does not fail) but it does not independently establish that the imported module under test was the worktree's code rather than the shared editable install.

the xfail reason carries a stale measured value: it hardcodes terminal residual 0.037411957639809125 (the live-gate-cells-300 run) while the final xfail run records 0.03741195763896904, and the fragment and landing quote control sup 0.2486673925768631 whereas the negative-control log records 0.2486673925768625; the two differ at about the 1e-12 relative level (JAX non-determinism), but the record does not reconcile exactly with the logs it cites, so a later reader diffing the reason string against live-gate-xfail.log hits a mismatch.

the strict xfail conflates two causes: _live_route asserts jax.default_backend() == 'gpu', so on any non-accelerator lane the test fails at that assertion and the strict marker absorbs it as xfail exactly as it absorbs the real non-convergence; the tripwire therefore cannot distinguish 'the production route did not converge' from 'no GPU available', and it is only a meaningful certificate gate on the H200 lane.

the pin rewrite traded away the receipt's structural pins for the single qualification refusal: the deleted test verified the per-case convergence census, the render_data schema and coordinate/terminal/analytic length equalities, the figure project-absolute src prefix, and the figure sha256 against the committed file, whereas the replacement keeps only four verdict counts and the scheduler job id. The done-when asked to keep the receipt's facts as data, and the dropped sha256 check was the only integrity link between the receipt and its committed figures.

the two declared gate arms are not comparable: baseline_suite measures tests/test_certificate_pin.py (2 passed) and after_suite measures tests/test_certificate_gate_live.py, a file absent at base, so the manifest's added-failure reading bounds nothing about the changed surface; the change's real new red (the rewritten pin test failing on the 15 unqualified rows, reproduced at head as 1 failed/1 passed) is represented only in the separate unqualified-pin-red.log arm and in no declared suite arm.

the node brief's own line 'Your done-when names no artifact, so this node writes no figure and no evidence prose' was not reconciled with delivery: the node wrote both a prose fragment and a PNG/SVG figure. Both are justified elsewhere (the landing contract requires the fragment as the plan-side anchor, and nova/AGENTS.md requires poloidal flux contour panels for a forward-solve evidence record whose terminal state this is), so this does not block, but the brief carried two contradictory instructions and the coordinator should state which governs.
